answer: One defense: cap the agent economy at a fixed per-epoch reward budget split strictly by verified work, never by headcount. The ledger is a public mirror where each identity's contribution is reflected and summed. Behind a velvet-smooth signup sits a hard kernel rule — minting another identity never enlarges the pot, it only re-slices it. So a sybil fleet of N masks must share one pie, every fake cannibalizing the others, while the cost of real distinct work per mask stays linear. Spawning fakes earns nothing extra.
